tools.name: files_hash
tools.description: Show the SHA-256 checksum of each file.

tools.name: id_passport_photo
tools.description: Make a photo that passes the passport or visa rules of a country, with live pass, warn and fail checks.

tools.name: id_print_sheet
tools.description: Put several copies of this photo on one sheet for the print shop, at the exact size.

tools.name: id_signature_cleaner
tools.description: Turn a photo of your signature into a clean transparent PNG.

tools.name: image_compress
tools.description: Make this image smaller without it looking worse, or fit it under a size.

tools.name: image_convert
tools.description: Turn this image into another format and keep its colors, orientation and details.

tools.name: image_erase
tools.description: Paint over something and make it disappear. Give a mask picture as the second file (white is erased), or a rectangle.

tools.name: image_remove_background
tools.description: Cut the subject out: a transparent PNG, a solid color or a blurred background.

tools.name: image_remove_watermark
tools.description: Remove a watermark, logo or date stamp from pictures you own. Finds the mark, then fills it in.

tools.name: image_resize
tools.description: Make this image an exact size, a percentage, or fit a longest side.

tools.name: image_resize_to_kb
tools.description: Fit a photo to the exact pixels and KB a form or exam portal asks for.

tools.name: image_strip_metadata
tools.description: Remove location, camera details or everything hidden in a photo, without touching its pixels.

tools.name: image_to_text
tools.description: Copy the text out of this picture.

tools.name: image_upscale
tools.description: Make a small or soft picture 2 or 4 times bigger and sharper.

tools.name: media_compress
tools.description: Make this video small enough to send or upload, under a size or as small as looks good.

tools.name: media_convert
tools.description: Turn this video or audio file into MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and more.

tools.name: media_extract_audio
tools.description: Pull the sound out of a video, as it is stored or as MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, Opus.

tools.name: media_hdr_to_sdr
tools.description: Fix the washed-out look of an iPhone or HDR video on screens that are not HDR.

tools.name: media_info
tools.description: Tell me everything about this video or audio file and what is wrong with it.

tools.name: media_normalize
tools.description: Make the loudness even and meet the broadcast or podcast standard.

tools.name: media_repair
tools.description: This video will not play: find out why and fix it.

tools.name: media_streams
tools.description: Take out, drop or relabel the audio, subtitle and video tracks of a file.

tools.name: media_to_mono
tools.description: Make it mono, swap the sides, split into two files or merge two mono files.

tools.name: media_trim
tools.description: Cut out the parts you do not want, without re-encoding what does not have to be.

tools.name: pdf_compress
tools.description: Make this PDF small enough to email or upload.

tools.name: pdf_images_to_pdf
tools.description: Make a PDF from these pictures, one per page.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Put these PDFs in one file.

tools.name: pdf_ocr
tools.description: Make this scan searchable and selectable.

tools.name: pdf_organize
tools.description: Reorder, delete, rotate or pull out pages.

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Cut this PDF into parts by page ranges or every N pages.

tools.name: pdf_to_images
tools.description: Turn each page of this PDF into a PNG or JPG picture.
